mapper.insert: INSERT INTO applications (job_id, candidate_id, cv_id, status, cover_letter, source, referral_code, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, applied_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{candidateId}, #{cvId}, #{status}, #{coverLetter}, #{source}, #{referralCode}, #{utmSource}, #{utmMedium}, #{utmCampaign}, #{appliedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM applications WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND is_deleted = FALSE )
